summary: A painted landscape plate from a seeded recipe, generated on the GPU at load: planes of sky, ranges, shore, water and leaves with haze by depth and brush strokes, drawn as a screen-locked backdrop or read back as a still.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Decides every peak, tree, cloud and leaf inside the recipe's bounds.

inputs.label: Haze
inputs.help: How thick the air is: 1 is the recipe's.

inputs.label: Clouds
inputs.help: Below 0 clears the sky, above 0 fills it.

inputs.label: Near leaves
inputs.help: Leave the near branch and leaves out when something else fills the foreground.
